name: shinchantw_cbt_d0_single_first_charge_d1_touchpoints_20260730_164218_300417
sql:
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
D0NewUsers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18
    WHERE "$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND "$part_event" = 'new_role'
),
D0SinglePayers AS (
    SELECT e."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    INNER JOIN D0NewUsers n ON e."#account_id" = n.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND e."$part_event" = 'charge'
      AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
      AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
),
TargetUsers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.account_id
    FROM D0SinglePayers p
    INNER JOIN ta.v_event_18 e ON p.account_id = e."#account_id"
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-30'
      AND e."$part_event" = 'charge'
      AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
      AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
TouchpointEvents AS (
    SELECT
        e."$part_date" AS event_date,
        e."#account_id" AS account_id,
        COALESCE(e."#event_name", e."$part_event") AS event_name
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    INNER JOIN TargetUsers t ON e."#account_id" = t.account_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-30'
      AND REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(COALESCE(e."#event_name", e."$part_event", '')), 'shop|store|mall|pay|charge|recharge|purchase|gift|pack|offer|popup')
)
SELECT
    event_date AS "日期",
    event_name AS "疑似付费触点事件",
    COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS "触达用户数",
    COUNT(*) AS "事件次数",
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT account_id), 0), 2) AS "人均触点次数"
FROM TouchpointEvents
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, "触达用户数" DESC, "事件次数" DESC
